description: Zeroes ONE channel of a multichannel file, in place: on stereo input with channo 2 the output is still stereo with L bit-equal to the source and R all-zero (verified sample-exact). channo's legal range is the INPUT's channel count, runtime-quoted ('(1.000000 to 2.000000)' on stereo, '(1.000000 to 1.000000)' on mono). MONO input takes a special path (banner: 'mono file goes to just one side of stereo outfile'): channo 1 yields a STEREO file with channel 1 zeroed and the mono signal on channel 2 - but this path has a verified BUG: one sample is dropped to 0.0 every 16384 frames (zeros found at frames 16384/32768/49152/65536/98304 where the source is nonzero; the stereo-input path is artifact-free) - hence version_sensitive. Duration static, sample-exact; deterministic. This is the curatable 'channel surgery' member of the chans family - the true split modes (1: extract one channel, 2: extract all) take no outfile argv and are engine-dropped with naming records (input stem + '_c<n>', harvestable via execute()).
musical_use: One-sided placement without a mixer: silence the right channel to park a stereo element hard left while keeping a 2-channel file that slots straight into stereo chains (no mono/stereo mismatch errors downstream). Zero one side of a stereo render, process the survivor, and re-merge with submix interleave for independent-channel processing that stays sample-aligned. The mono path (mono in, one-sided stereo out) is the quick 'put this voice on the right only' move - mind the 16384-frame dropped-sample bug on that path: inaudible on most material (isolated single-sample zeros) but real; prefer housekeep chans 5 + this mode's stereo path when bit-cleanliness matters.

channo.description: The channel to ZERO (1-based). CDP-enforced 1 to the input's channel count, runtime-quoted ('Parameter[1] Value (3.000000) out of range (1.000000 to 2.000000)' on stereo; on mono only 1 is legal and selects the mono-to-one-side-of-stereo path).

examples.description: Silence the right channel of a stereo file.
examples.expected_use: Output stereo: L bit-equal to source, R digital silence. Duration unchanged.

examples.description: Put a mono sound on the right side of a fresh stereo file.
examples.expected_use: Mono input -> stereo output with ch1 zeroed, source on ch2 (subject to the 16384-frame single-sample bug on this path).

known_issues: MONO-PATH BUG (first-class, version_sensitive): mono input -> one-sided stereo drops ONE sample to 0.0 every 16384 frames (verified at 16384/32768/49152/65536/98304; ~2.7 zeros/second at 44.1 kHz). The stereo-input path is verified artifact-free. For bit-clean one-sided stereo: housekeep chans 5 (mono->stereo) then this mode's stereo path.
channo range is input-dependent (1..channels) - the refusal quotes the per-file bound.
Multichannel (>2) inputs: banner says one channel is zeroed in place (stereo verified; >2 unprobed beyond acceptance elsewhere in the family).

Split modes 1 (extract channo) and 2 (extract all) have NO outfile argv (auto-named '<input_stem>_c<n>.wav' in cwd, content verified bit-equal to the channel) - engine-incompatible, reachable via execute() with cwd control (tranche 11b drop records).
